reviewer: independent clean-context UI and capture acceptance

scope.otherItems: Items 3 and 4 have a separate reference-occurrence review.
scope.isolation: Private temporary builds and projects, random loopback ports, fresh headless browser profiles/contexts. Active port 4317, the actual user board, user browsers, OS clipboard and Keychain were untouched.

perItem.result: Annotation editors, chips and background capture have no Capture required, capture Retry or Capturing surface. Cancellation, ownership checks, persisted evidence recovery and Send completeness remain active. Lost PNG and a real synchronous copy failure preserve the comment, block incomplete Send, and recover through Done.
independentTests: managed React delayed saves retain the newer target and capture cancellation invalidates late uploads
managed React refresh exposes a lost captured image and explicitly recaptures a new version
independent real copy failure preserves text and recovers through another Done

perItem.result: Collapsed comments have theme-specific alpha 0.84 surfaces, 4px/8px padding and 7px radius. Canvas draws the visible surface/text and DOM opacity preserves the semantic click/focus input. Actual Canvas and saved PNG sample pixels agree; long region text stays inside the padded surface at CSS zoom. Point numbering remains anchored at the actual click.

Object-side selected actions retain Remove and Align; Attach and Annotate are absent. Global Mark, selection preview confirmation and @ search remain working entrances. Video playback controls remain connected to the original component and callbacks.
independentTests: refinement Mark hover and clicks share displayed content ownership and clear their guides
chatbox selection previews are consumed by real input focus, Escape and direct reference-only Send
chatbox @ search orders object and task identities and keeps IME, paste and attachment semantics

perItem.result: Hover and click lock use presentedMarkTarget with the same displayed frame objects/layers. Letterbox bodies shield lower content, higher-layer occluders and 22px rounded audio corners are respected. Global Mark overlays native controls and HTML; Target is absent. The editor holds its target until Redraw, which hides the active editor for picking. Leave, cancellation, pan, zoom and presented producer updates clear or recompute hover. Same reader activation preserves the fresh editor during touch synthesized clicks.
independentTests: presented Mark ownership respects letterbox opaque bodies rounded corners and every crossing occluder
refinement Mark hover and clicks share displayed content ownership and clear their guides
point pins and captured rings share actual blank and normalized clicks across pan zoom DPR themes and touch
independent same ID redraw takes the new marker and target on immediate Done

perItem.result: Actual audio/video editor geometry keeps text, media and footer apart, keeps at least 64 local CSS px text height, and exposes a real pointer hit on Done. Light/dark 320px, long multiline text, CSS zoom 1.25/0.8, 480px height and resizing an already open scaled editor pass.

Object crops enclose the presented layer rendered bounds, target and actual same-frame pin plus 16 CSS px. Region crops retain 96 CSS px context. The actual CSS viewport, bitmap ratios, DPR and page clipping control copied pixels. App verifies same-ID target equality and marker availability, waits at most two RAFs for real presentation, and synchronously copies pixels before draft/encoding/network work. Six actual producers preserve the copied N through N+5 and source movement/deletion. Unavailable copy produces no synthetic scene source.

closedFindings.failure: At 320px with CSS zoom 1.25 a newly opened editor was 360 physical px wide and Done was clipped.
closedFindings.fix: Visible-size measurement applies actual page/Canvas scale and limits the reader width and height before placing it.
closure: independent media layout stays usable under CSS zoom and short viewport
CSS zoom keeps edge annotation controls visible and copies only the presented pixels within the page

closedFindings.failure: An open editor retained its wide maximum width after 1200px to 320px resize at CSS zoom 1.25; Done.right was 353 and its pointer hit failed.
closedFindings.fix: Every layout/ResizeObserver pass recomputes the real available size and target dimensions, and cancels an obsolete animation when size changes.
closedFindings.closure: independent expanded comment stays reachable when its page is resized under CSS zoom

closedFindings.failure: A narrowed collapsed region surface ended at x306 while fixed-width summary text ended at x312, outside its background and right padding.
closedFindings.fix: Summary max-width follows its parent content box while retaining the preferred 204px width.
closedFindings.closure: independent collapsed region comments keep their text inside the padded surface at CSS zoom

reproduction.cwd: Run emitted tests from the private candidate, link its node_modules and required binary tests/fixtures read-only to the project, and set ACANVAS_TEST_WEB_ROOT to candidate/web.
reproduction.supplemental: Extract the fixture/import prefix before the first test() from the compiled tests/chatbox-ui.test.js and append ui-review-artifacts/independent-ui-extra-body.js to candidate/tests/independent-ui-extra.test.js. Run with Node 24 --test.
reproduction.permissions: Initial sandbox loopback listen returned EPERM; the independent browser checks completed with approved temporary loopback/headless execution.

validationLimits: One isolated Chromium browser application was reproduced independently. Production HTML used the explicit isolated Chromium surface engine. This review adds no new CEF or cross-browser matrix claim.
The existing broader capture/runtime matrix and full browser matrix are separate records. This review ran the targeted source, UI, crop and ownership acceptance scope.
